TEXT:
After struggling to leave Akiba, I received another 
text from Akagi.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
Hey Kousaka, how has Sena been since? Anything 
about the guy I mentioned?

Rest easy, Akagi. Your sister's been talking nonstop 
about men earlier, but I didn't even catch a 
glimpse of the guy you're looking for.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Okay, Senpai. This is commonly referred to as the 
Maiden Road!
Yup, we're in Ikebukuro.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Hey, check it out! There isn't a lot compared to 
Akiba, but there are many doujin shops here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You seem way more excited than you were in 
Akiba, though...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Fufufu... The stores around here are packed full of 
treasures that grab the hearts of maidens...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If this were an RPG, this would be the city where 
all the magicians gather to buy magical items! 
Gotta save up your gold and buy in bulk, uhyuu!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If this is all magic, I only see black magic here...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
If Gokou-san was here she'd definitely say 
something like, "What an atrocious rotten smell... this 
must be the symposium of necromancy...!"

This girl's out of control, she's getting so worked up 
that she's being sarcastic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
H... Hey, I'm getting tired, how about you? We've 
been walking the entire time since Akiba. Wanna 
take a break?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I'm still good to go, but... we haven't had lunch yet, 
wanna get something to eat?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, sure! Let's take a break and eat.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Then, let's do that!

Phew, I managed to buy some time for her to 
calm down and make my life easier in the process. 
Or so I thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I recommend this place♪

SPEAKER: SPK_BUTLER
TEXT: Welcome back, M'lady, M'lord.
-It's a butler café!!

Yeah, should've noticed. There's that maid café in 
Akiba that Kirino and her group patronized, of 
course such a place would exist in Ikebukuro too...!

Dropping my shoulders while taking my seat, Sena 
made a meek expression and spoke.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai, please be careful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Be careful of...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, right. There has to be some etiquette for a 
butler café. Stuff that I shouldn't do, anything like 
that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: No, nothing like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
There are many fantastic butlers here, so be 
careful not to fall in love with one.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]Like heck I will!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Oh really? When we entered, you kept stealing 
glances at them...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I've never been to a place like this, I stared out of 
curiosity!

It's natural to be distracted by the sights of such 
an elaborate design. I can't even have that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Do you always have this irresistible urge of pairing 
people up whenever you see two or more guys 
together...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Not at all, it doesn't matter if the target is inorganic, 
represented by symbols, or even a general concept, 
I get off by equally pairing them up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That isn't something to say while puffing your chest 
out with pride.

Puffing out that massive chest while acting so 
smug. What are you saying with that triumphant 
look?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Besides, the fact that I have to pair you with 
someone is your fault, not mine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You release an aura that's begging to be 
dominated so... I just can't take my eyes off you...

I don't understand the "begging to be dominated" 
part. But since it's scary to think that I might end 
up like Makabe-kun, I won't ask.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Just look at the customers around you, see? 
Everyone's already writing short stories in their 
head about you and a butler...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_A
TEXT:
Hey, isn't he giving a great [font_size=28]bottom[/font_size] aura? 
It's almost like a talent...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_B
TEXT:
A story about him coming here for the 
first time and a butler giving him a 
private [font_size=28]training[/font_size] might work...!

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_C
TEXT:
Sounds great!! His appearance is pretty normal for 
a bottom but, that makes it better...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=28]Th-This place is scary![/font_size] I feel like I should 
have never entered here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
H-Hey, you. Bring me something to eat so I can 
leave!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You can't say "you!" you have to say "Hey, boy." or 
something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh!? ...H-Hey, boy... Um, I leave it to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_BUTLER
TEXT: Certainly. Here is our menu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah...

When I leaned over to get the menu dropped by 
the butler, our hands touched-

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_A
TEXT:
[font_size=28]The flag has arrived! Their first contact 
with each other-----!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_B
TEXT:
No doubt about it. That's the bottom's usual mating 
call...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_C
TEXT: Making an excuse this quickly... what a fearsome kid...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[font_size=26]W-W-Wait, trying to pick up a dropped 
menu, th-th-th-then their hands touched!!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[font_size=26]H-Hey, if you're doing this, then aren't you 
cheating on Onii-chan!?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You're making too much out of just fingers 
touching!

W-What's with this, putting Sena aside, why is 
everyone around us whispering!

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_A
TEXT:
Wow... He has a boyfriend, yet he's using such 
devious tactics...

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_B
TEXT:
Touching each other, then connecting with their 
bodies...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_WOMAN_C
TEXT: I knew our eyes didn't deceive us!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What... should I do...!

-After that, I don't remember much about what 
happened.

I probably gave up resisting and just quietly ate a 
meal there.

There's also the feeling of being surrounded by a 
bunch of elder sisters going nuts over me and the 
butler.

I vaguely remember people asking for a photo of 
me with the butler, but my consciousness was 
already far gone at that point...

Anyway, the data collection, or rather the BL 
research session, was over.
......Man, I'm exhausted.
